title: Monotonicity of the OR function
statement: For every natural number $n$, the OR function on sign vectors of length $n$, which returns $1$ exactly when every coordinate is $1$ and returns $-1$ otherwise, is monotone: if one input is at most another in every coordinate under the order $-1<1$, then its output is at most the other's under the same order.
